SEARCH
Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.query

Interface Where

All Known Implementing Classes:
SearchWhere, Where.Basic, Where.Between, Where.BetweenColumns, Where.Column, Where.DateBased, Where.In, Where.Like, Where.Nested, Where.NotIn, Where.NotNull, Where.Null, Where.NullSafeEquals, Where.Raw, Where.ValueBetween, WhereExists, WhereInSub, WhereRowValues, WhereSub, WhereSubValue
@Internal public interface Where
One condition of a where clause, as the Builder records it and a QueryGrammar compiles it.

Laravel keeps each condition as an untyped map with a type key and dispatches on the string; here each type is a class, so a grammar reads typed fields. The types are plain final classes, not records or a sealed hierarchy, because the library runs on Android API 28, which has neither; a grammar that meets a type it does not know fails with IllegalStateException.

Every condition carries its conjunction: and, or, and not or or not. Values are the caller's values before binding; an Expression value is written into the SQL instead of bound. List fields are unmodifiable copies and may hold null. A Where.Nested condition returns a copy of its builder, so every condition is effectively immutable.

Conditions that hold a subquery are top-level classes in this package: WhereSub, WhereSubValue, WhereInSub, WhereExists, plus WhereRowValues.

API Note:
Internal: read by dialect grammars; may change without notice.
